summary: Preserve complete doctor JSON on pipes when large MCP catalogs produce hundreds of findings

delivery.outcome: Doctor prescribe and heal emit valid, complete JSON for a 422-tool MCP catalog; regression captures pipe output and confirms last record.
nonGoals: Changing diagnostic findings or healing authority
Editing MCP bridge, dashboard, shared manifests or documentation index

architecture.decision: Synchronous stdout writes complete the JSON before existing process exits. Exercise real CLI programs via pipes against a deterministic diagnostic fixture and run the actual full MCP inventory. This is a serialized follow-up to ticket030, not a concurrent writer.
architecture.rollback: Revert only doctor output changes; preserve imported MCP packages and existing runtime receipts.

validation.evidence: Real CLI pipe output for large diagnostic payloads; full 422-candidate catalog contract checks.
